----------

##1 Incursion:

* A raid-like mission with a group of 4.

* Two difficulties modes (Hard, Challenging).

* No checkpoints (everyone dies, you restart the entire mission)

* Recommended and required gear score, (Hard has no requirement, Challenging has a required minimum.)

* Will include new mechanics (Including drones [flying autonomous vehicles] )

* APC Boss that cannot be killed with regular weapons. * Weekly reward reset.

* Can be replayed as many times as you can complete it.

* Can obtain weekly reward on all characters.

----------

##Item Trading:

* Items can be traded within your group.

* 2 hour time limit.

* Can be traded infinitely until timer expires.

* You drop the item on the ground, anyone in the group can pick it up.

* Cannot drop items in the dark zone, only in checkpoints.

* Only the people who were there when the item dropped can trade the item.

----------

##Supply Drops:

* New darkzone activity.

* Has non-contaminated loot (Doesn't need to be extracted)

* Can be used right away.

* Will be heavily guarded by NPCs

----------

##Gear Sets:

* New items that are more powerful when the set is completed.

* Will have new talents never seen.

* Gear set items will be shown in a light teal color.

* Will accommodate certain styles of play (ex. Electronics focused, Marksman focus, etc.)

* Can be obtained from challenging missions, open world bosses, incursions, and darkzone play.

* Will include a Dark Zone focused set, no info is known about this set.

* Will not make older gear obsolete.

----------

##Gear Score

* Replacing Item Score

* Calculates all items on your character AND in your bag to define combat effectiveness.

* Used for minimum requirements in Incursions.

----------

##Spectator Camera:

* Follow teammates characters while dead.

* Full 360 degree camera control.

----------

##Future Incursions:

* Will include more new mechanics.

* New factions.

* New locations.

* Further along the story.

----------

##Assignments

* Daily and weekly objectives

* Can be simultaneously completed while doing other tasks in-game.

Example: Kill 20 Rikers.

----------
